idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production following its deploy. Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. Rollback completed and verified. Recommend investigating v2.3.1 before re-deploying; note v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so redeployment will require change-manager approval.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (the v2.3.1-rc release was only healthy in staging, so it was not a candidate).
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.
3. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and next steps (on-call has been paged). Also noted that redeploying v2.3.1 will require change-manager approval since it has never been healthy in production.
